items.description: Clothing and jewellery stolen from the car
items.rationale: Policy section 2.1 and 3.1.4: The removal of property by a third party (theft, even with force or entry) is not an insured peril under this residential dwelling policy. Section 4.3(d) further excludes movable property of the household (clothing, jewellery) from cover. Reference Case 35 confirms t = 0 for this scenario.
Policy section 5.2.5 and 4.3(e): Expenditure connected with a conveyance (vehicle) is not an insured cost, and vehicles are not insured property. Reference Case 35 confirms t = 0 for this scenario.
